scope: Preserve the complete typed SORTENTSTABLE payload when counted entity soft-pointer slots decode to null, while retaining strict output refusal for unresolved targets.

formatEvidence.finding: The body carries one sort handle per entry; the handle stream carries the owner and numentries entity handles as soft pointers. This specifies the field role and count, but does not establish null entity targets as valid members.

independentPeer.finding: The same object has 3,222 sort handles and 3,222 entity slots; exactly 14 entity slots decode to handle zero. Peer success corroborates payload shape and values, not validity of the null graph edges.

implementation.change: The SORTENTSTABLE parser accepts a correctly typed soft-pointer slot with ref zero and retains it in sequence. Static source-membership validation keeps the counted row and ordinal instead of rejecting the decoded null value. The adapter's strict owner/target graph continues to reject target zero before publication to DXF. The DWG writer also refuses null entity targets.
implementation.scopeLimit: Tolerant read preservation only. The source graph is not qualified for DXF output, and no format-level validity claim is made for null members.
